item.title: Command overview
item.description: Browse the full command surface grouped by workflow phase. The order stays aligned with the upstream catalog while this site owns the localized explanations.

item.title: Adapt
item.description: Make designs work across screens, devices, and contexts without amputating features.

item.title: Animate
item.description: Purposeful motion that conveys state, not decoration.

item.title: Audit
item.description: Five-dimension technical quality check with P0 to P3 severity.

item.title: Bolder
item.description: Push safe designs toward impact without sliding into chaos.

item.title: Clarify
item.description: Rewrite confusing UX copy so interfaces explain themselves.

item.title: Colorize
item.description: Add strategic color to monochrome interfaces without going garish.

item.title: Craft
item.description: Shape the design, then build it, all in one flow.

item.title: Critique
item.description: A design review with scoring, persona tests, and automated detection.

item.title: Delight
item.description: Small moments of personality that turn functional into memorable.

item.title: Distill
item.description: Ruthless subtraction. Strip designs to their essence.

item.title: Document
item.description: Generate a spec-compliant DESIGN.md that captures your visual system so every AI agent stays on-brand.

item.title: Extract
item.description: Pull reusable components, tokens, and patterns into the design system.

item.title: Harden
item.description: Make interfaces production-ready. Edge cases, i18n, error states, overflow.

item.title: Impeccable
item.description: The design intelligence behind every command.

item.title: Layout
item.description: Fix layout, spacing, and visual rhythm.

item.title: Live
item.description: Iterate on UI in the browser. Pick an element, drop a comment, get three variants. Accept one and it writes to source.

item.title: Onboard
item.description: Design first-run experiences, empty states, and paths to value.

item.title: Optimize
item.description: Diagnose and fix UI performance from LCP to bundle size.

item.title: Overdrive
item.description: Push an interface past conventional limits. Shaders, physics, 60fps, cinematic transitions.

item.title: Polish
item.description: The meticulous final pass between good and great.

item.title: Quieter
item.description: Tone down designs that are shouting without losing their intent.

item.title: Shape
item.description: Think before you build. Produce a design brief through discovery, not guesswork.

item.title: Teach
item.description: Teach Impeccable who your product is for, once per project.

item.title: Typeset
item.description: Fix typography that feels generic, inconsistent, or accidental.
